correctness.rationale: For smooth normalized components invoke the cited Fantechi–Göttsche integral CSM zero-cycle theorem. CSM constructible-function pushforward for a two-point finite pinch has fiber count m+1 and one-pushed-point correction m, giving 1_{S^nZ}=(S^n f)_*1_{S^nY}−(+p)_*(S^(n−1)f)_*1_{S^(n−1)Y}. Proper CSM pushforward turns this into E_Z=E_Y(1−[p]t); finite point-pinch factorization followed by a finite bijection proves the arbitrary reduced curve case, while nilpotent thickenings do not alter ordinary Chow zero cycles. For g_i>=1 each smooth curve has E_C=product of 2g_i−2 negative canonical point factors, hence exact degree D=Σ(2g_i−2)+Σ(b_p−1), with nonzero top degree (−1)^D. Checked m+1−m=1 combinatorially for arbitrary m; earlier irreducible-curve theorem and integral pushforward are substantive cited inputs.
